en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增 Antigravity CLI，支持全局和独立配置模式下的聊天、群聊与工作流，并接入原生配置、MCP 和技能管理 (#3256)
- 新增 APIKEY.FAN 中转服务页面，可按已配置的 API Key 查看余额、今日与累计用量及模型明细 (#3257)
- 修复编程 Agent 手动检查更新后的状态和更新版本识别，并保护正在运行的会话 (#3261)
- 修复 Claude 回复提前结束、内容缺失或重复的问题，完整保存最终输出 (#3260、#3263)
- 修复 macOS 上 Antigravity 全局模式无法读取原生登录凭据的问题，并更正登录提示 (#3266)
- 设备连接导航改用显示器与手机图标，更清晰地区分连接入口 (#3262)
What's Changed
- fix(navigation): use monitor and phone for device connections by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3262
- fix(claude): prevent early completion from dropping native output by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3260
- feat: add API relay partner page and per-key usage by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3257
- fix(claude): deduplicate reindexed assistant text snapshots by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3263
- fix(agent-updates): refresh manual update state and guard active sessions by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3261
- feat(coding-agents): add Antigravity CLI global integration by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3256
- fix(antigravity): preserve macOS keychain access in global mode by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3266
- chore: bump Studio and desktop to 0.7.28 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3267
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.27...v0.7.28
